title: Observation secret and transient-data hygiene policy

detector_authority.reason: The vendored credential catalogue has exactly one owner. This policy binds class identities to that owner's public detectors instead of restating its patterns; only the transient corpus, which needs byte spans the upstream surface does not expose, is implemented here.

payload_limits.reason: A bounded ceiling is checked before any regular expression runs, so a hostile payload cannot force unbounded scan work. It bounds the canonical JSON bytes of the whole provider-bound envelope the pipeline is handed — the settled canonical record plus the observation kind and payload contract wrapper the journey adds — not the canonical record alone. Exceeding it is an admission error, not a classification: nothing about the payload's content has been examined. The ceiling is deliberately above the canonical store's 1 MiB record ceiling plus that wrapper, and the structural depth ceiling is derived from the store's depth ceiling plus envelope headroom, so a record the host already settled can never trip either; only input that no store would have accepted does. A mounted journey that still meets this error over evidence the host already settled records it as a withheld row with reason unclassifiable_payload — digests only, zero findings — so the replay cursor advances and the canonical record stays untouched.

receipt.domain_separation_reason: A delivered receipt and a withheld audit row are different objects with different field sets, so they are framed under different domains. Reusing the receipt domain for a withheld identity would let one derivation's input be replayed as the other's.

reject_floor_signals.reason: The shared credential corpus is reached through detect_secret_like, which reports only the FIRST pattern that matched a string. A string carrying a credential-like assignment and a live issuer token therefore reports whichever pattern the catalogue happens to order first, and attributing that single reason to the whole string is how a payload that must be withheld ends up merely redacted. Admission runs an independent multi-signal pass: the declared direct signals are checked against the whole string, and the shared detector is re-probed over bounded candidate substrings so a class the first answer hid is still proven. The pass may only ADD reject-floor classes; it never lowers a class the shared corpus already proved, it stores no matched byte, and an exhausted probe budget classifies as detector_unavailable so the pipeline fails closed.

classes.rationale: A PEM block is a self-identifying live credential. Shipping the surrounding structure with the key excised normalizes leak-adjacent traffic, and the neighbouring context is usually the same key in another encoding.
A presented bearer token is usable the moment it is read; the event that carried it should never have been observed.
AKIA, gh[pousr]_, sk- and the rest of the vendored catalogue identify a specific issuer's live credential.

The public detector proves a high-entropy token is present but does not expose its byte span, so it cannot be redacted in place without guessing. Withholding the provider-bound copy is the fail-closed answer; the canonical evidence is retained untouched.
A detector that failed to compile has proven nothing about the payload. Fail closed.
A bounded value inside otherwise durable structure. The canonical redactor knows the exact span, so the fact survives without the credential.
The object key proves the value is a credential. Sibling keys are durable knowledge and are preserved verbatim.

classes.detector_reason: credential material in an object key
classes.rationale: Credential material in a key cannot be redacted in place without guessing a span, and a guessed span can leave the real value intact. Quarantine is the fail-closed answer the canonical sanitizer already models.
A pid is unambiguous ephemeral instance data with an exact span, and the sentence around it is often durable.
Only an instance-shaped leaf is redacted: a final component of at least eight characters containing a digit. A documented stable path such as /tmp/cache is durable knowledge and is left alone.
Ordinary code facts routinely document a bind address. The finding is recorded on the receipt and the bytes are left untouched; retention is the provider's decision, not a silent rewrite of the fact.
Run-log phrasing appears inside legitimate prose about behaviour. Annotate rather than rewrite.

invariants: Sanitization runs once, at admission, before any digest, observation identity, or idempotency key is derived.
The pipeline reads canonical evidence through a shared reference and returns a new provider-bound value; it never mutates, consumes, or deletes its input.
A transient detection can at most redact a span inside the provider-bound copy; it can never withhold an observation and can never remove canonical evidence.
A withheld observation is never dispatched and never acquires a terminal code; its receipt identity and source digest let the journal advance its replay cursor without persisting a payload.
Every delivered receipt binds the exact sanitized bytes: accepted receipts report identical source and sanitized digests, redacted receipts report different ones.
No matched byte, redacted value, or source text ever enters a finding, a receipt, a receipt identifier, or an error.

An object key that is itself credential material never enters a structural location, including the location of a finding on any value nested beneath that key; the key slot is named by an opaque marker instead.
The reject floor is evaluated over every class a string carries, not only the first class the shared detector reports.
A byte difference between the source payload and the canonical redactor's output that no finding explains is an admission error, never a fabricated finding.

The canonical redactor runs a wider detector profile than the classification scan, so a class only it can prove still withholds the observation when the policy withholds for that class; its rewritten bytes are discarded rather than delivered.
A payload with no findings is delivered byte-identical to its source; the pipeline never re-encodes a clean payload.
A reject-floor class can be raised in severity by configuration but never lowered.
